title: rubus arcticus subsp. acaulis
intro: Rubus arcticus subsp. acaulis, commonly known as Arctic Bramble or Arctic Raspberry, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family, Rubaceae. This plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and tannins, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus arcticus subsp. acaulis include pain relief, wound healing, and gastrointestinal protection, due to its bioactive constituents such as salicylic acid, ellagic acid, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
